groups.name: usb_pwr_in
groups.why: USB-C power/OTG input on the west edge: ESD on its D+/D- (to Module302), the 10u +5V bulk cap at the entry, the +5V bleeder, the VBUS test point

groups.name: usb2_host
groups.why: USB-C USB2 host port: its ESD, the VBUS power switch U701 with ILIM resistor and VBUS caps (100uF + 10u), the 22k CC pull-ups

groups.name: hdmi
groups.why: HDMI type A: three ESD arrays (D403 on B for CEC/DDC/HPD), the HDMI 5V load switch U405 and its output cap

groups.name: ethernet
groups.why: RJ45 MagJack (mid-mount, locked in the NW notch): the two TPD4EUSB30 ESD arrays (B) on its pairs, LED resistors, shield 0R, centre-tap cap

groups.name: camera
groups.why: CSI camera FFC (FH12-22S), its four DPHY0 lanes + clock from Module302 and the camera GPIO/I2C from Module301; held on the south edge

groups.name: cm5
groups.why: the CM5 connectors (fixed) with the +5V decaps at the module's +5V pins, GPIO_VREF 0R select, EEPROM write-protect pull-down, the rail and GND test points

groups.name: m2_power
groups.why: AP3441 buck +5V -> M2_3V3: inductor, input caps, output caps, feedback divider + feed-forward cap, EN pull-down

groups.name: m2_slot
groups.why: M.2 M-key socket (fixed): bulk caps at its 3V3 pins, the 32.768 kHz SUSCLK oscillator with its decap, the activity LED and resistor

groups.name: i2c_sensor
groups.why: Qwiic I2C connector with its ESD and pull-ups, the LIS3DH accelerometer (B) on the same bus with its decaps and CS/SDO straps

groups.name: gpio_conn
groups.why: SPI display connector and fan connector, both wired only to Module301 GPIOs

groups.name: ui
groups.why: power button on the east edge with the power LED (inverter U602 + R605 + D605) and activity LED (R606 + D606)

groups.name: b_west
groups.why: the two tall B-side parts (RTC battery connector, nRPIBOOT button), both held on the west edge outside the CM5 module body
